supported_findings: All seven predictor checkpoint argument records store full_valid=true, include_heldout_valid=true, valid_fold=-1 and valid_train_fraction=1.0, with 10,607 train sequences and 600 validation sequences. The fin256ft_s3/s4 records say train_source=valid; fbc1k_s5, orgbase and w18final_distilled_s5 say train_source=train+valid. This is strong evidence that the stored recipes include the held-out validation scope, but stored args alone do not prove the historical loader's realized row membership.

fbc1k_s5@ep3 stores init='' and distill='fin256_s3,fin256_s4', with propensity='prop_f0'. w18final_distilled_s5@ep1 stores init='fbc1k_s5@ep3', distill='w18final_teacher', family_teachers='w18final_fbc1k_s5,w18final_family_full,w18final_family_raw,orgbase', and propensity='prop_f0'. These are separate initializer and distillation edges; the named teacher aliases are not resolved to exact checkpoint paths by this receipt.

The fin256ft_s3/s4 model.pt and model_ep1.pt objects store the same args per seed, including init='fin256_s3@ep3' or init='fin256_s4@ep3', train_source='valid', and loss='gcorr'. The ep1 objects report epoch=1; the model.pt objects omit an epoch field. Equal args and tensor schemas do not establish weight equality or identify model.pt as the terminal trained endpoint.

The prop_f0 checkpoint SHA-256 is 9e92f26d1704f84f9170d746b372c2ba67f7fb611831865a1fc689d6b813b21c, exactly matching the earlier cache-sidecar claim. Its metadata exposes hidden=64 and n_in=211 but no args or fit membership; the hash match does not establish training scope or clean-F0 provenance.

The seven predictor schemas report n_in=211 and float32 tensor metadata; orgbase has a 128-unit GRU body and two-output head, prop_f0 has a 64-unit GRU body and one-output head. No tensor values were emitted or reviewed.
limitations_and_next_closure_edges: Do not certify any member, teacher, initializer, or prop_f0 as a clean-F0 control. The stored args strengthen the held-out-inclusion concern, while exact realized membership still requires historical source/loader binding and ordered fit-group evidence.
